caption:
Lulu hauls stage gear from before sunrise, and by pack-down her shoulders and back feel knotted.

Carrying heavy gear solo with no breaks can tire your muscles out. Team lifts and short breathers can share the load, and massage can be one helpful way to support recovery.

Hybi's tip: before bump-in, do some arm circles and 10 squats, use a two-person lift for heavy cases, and gently stretch your shoulders and calves after pack-down.

Tingling, swelling or bruising after a knock, or pain that isn't settling, are worth checking first. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD remedial massage therapists can help. Book online via the link in bio 🎤
